description: Complete fiber cut at junction box BX-42. Affecting 3 cell sites, approximately 47000 customers. BGP routing failed over automatically but partial traffic loss observed.
root_cause: Physical fiber cut by third-party construction crew at coordinates Grid-47-N.
resolution: Activated backup fiber route via alternate path. Dispatched repair crew. Restored in 112 minutes.
prevention: Install conduit markers and notify construction companies of fiber routes.

description: Signal degradation on 4G network in sector CX-East. 12% packet loss, latency increased by 180ms. Approximately 8000 customers affected.
root_cause: Antenna misalignment on tower CX-T07 due to wind damage overnight.
resolution: Remote antenna tilt adjustment. Field inspection confirmed misalignment. Reset to nominal position.
prevention: Install wind-speed monitoring on towers in exposed locations.

description: Core network element failure in 5G standalone deployment. Service outage for all 5G SA customers in western region. Approximately 23000 customers affected.
root_cause: AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) software crash due to memory leak in build v3.4.1.
resolution: Rolled back AMF software to v3.4.0. Customers restored. Filed bug report with vendor.
prevention: Implement staged rollout for core network software upgrades with automated rollback trigger.

description: Microwave backhaul link MX-14 showing 40% capacity reduction. Downstream cell sites experiencing congestion.
root_cause: Rain fade on microwave link due to heavy precipitation. Frequency: 23GHz link susceptible to rain attenuation.
resolution: Temporarily rerouted traffic via fiber backup. Microwave link recovered automatically after precipitation ceased.
prevention: Configure automatic traffic rerouting triggers based on link utilisation thresholds.

description: Billing system database unresponsive. Customer self-service portal down. New activations blocked.
root_cause: Database connection pool exhausted due to batch job running concurrently with peak traffic period.
resolution: Terminated runaway batch job. Increased connection pool size. Added scheduling constraint to avoid peak hours.
prevention: Schedule batch jobs during maintenance window 02:00-05:00 UTC.

description: Primary DNS server unresponsive. Customers unable to resolve domain names. Secondary DNS handling load but showing elevated latency.
root_cause: Primary DNS server disk I/O saturation caused by runaway logging process writing to /var/log at 99% disk usage.
resolution: Cleared log directory. Restarted DNS service. Added log rotation policy.
prevention: Implement disk-usage alerting at 80% threshold. Apply log rotation to all production services.

description: Cell site TX-089 offline. Mains power failure. UPS activated but battery depleted after 4 hours.
root_cause: Grid power outage in industrial zone. UPS battery capacity insufficient for extended outage.
resolution: Deployed mobile generator. Site restored. UPS batteries scheduled for replacement.
prevention: Upgrade UPS capacity for sites in areas with frequent grid instability. Add generator auto-start.

description: VoLTE call drop rate increased to 15% (baseline 0.5%). Customers reporting calls dropping after 2-3 minutes.
root_cause: IMS session timer bug in SBC (Session Border Controller) firmware v2.8.3 causing premature session termination.
resolution: Emergency firmware rollback to v2.8.2. Call drop rate returned to baseline in 15 minutes.
prevention: Add VoLTE call success rate monitoring. Block firmware upgrades during business hours without rollback plan.

description: 4G network capacity exhausted in stadium district during major sporting event. All cells showing >100% PRB utilisation.
root_cause: Traffic surge 8x normal due to 70000 attendees at stadium event. Capacity planning did not account for event.
resolution: Deployed mobile cells on demand. Activated traffic prioritisation. Event concluded before full resolution.
prevention: Integrate event calendar into capacity planning. Pre-position mobile cells for large events.

description: Subsea fiber cut affecting international traffic routing. Significant latency increase on trans-Atlantic routes.
root_cause: Ship anchor damage to subsea fiber cable at coordinates 35.2N 12.4W.
resolution: Traffic rerouted via alternative subsea cable. Permanent repair requires cable ship deployment (ETA 72 hours).
prevention: Ensure diverse routing across at least 3 geographically separate subsea cables for international traffic.
